name: WP0 — Cleanup: remove AGENT_DONE_WORD agent loop and dead sub-task generation, de-duplicate routes
description:
BLOCKING preparation for long running tasks (LRT-1). Design contract: docs/long-running-tasks.md · Plan: docs/long-running-tasks-plan.md §2 WP0.

OBJECTIVE
Remove the deprecated agent recursion and the dead sub-task generation code, and leave exactly one startup hook and one mark-seen route.

SCOPE (open LRT-0 items 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.9)
1. Remove AGENT_DONE_WORD and the whole agent loop decision:
   - codx/junior/globals.py: delete AGENT_DONE_WORD, CHAT_MODE_AGENT (and get_agent_max_iterations if unused elsewhere).
   - codx/junior/chat/chat_engine.py: remove the recursion branch keyed on AGENT_DONE_WORD, the is_agent flags/headers and the agent refine prompt.
   - codx/junior/chat_prompt_builder.py: remove the agent-mode prompt flavour; _resolve_chat_mode_flags must treat mode="agent" like mode="chat" (no behaviour change beyond losing the recursion).
   - Remove append_agent_message and any AGENT header/flag plumbing.
2. Remove dead sub-task generation:
   - codx/junior/engine/chat_engine_actions.py: remove ChatEngineActions.generate_tasks.
   - CODXJuniorSession.generate_tasks: remove.
   - codx/junior/sio/sio.py: remove the codx-junior-subtasks handler.
   - codx/junior/app.py: remove the /api/chats/sub-tasks route and every call site.
3. De-duplicate:
   - codx/junior/app.py: exactly ONE @app.on_event("startup") (merge whatever the duplicate did).
   - codx/junior/api/chat.py: exactly ONE PUT /chats/mark-seen/... route.
   - Remove the legacy duplicated /api/chats and /api/kanban handlers in app.py that shadow the routers (keep the routers).

ACCEPTANCE (evidence required in the task report)
- grep -rn "AGENT_DONE_WORD" codx/ returns nothing.
- grep -rn "generate_tasks" codx/ returns only documentation strings, if any.
- grep -c "on_event(\"startup\")" codx/junior/app.py == 1; mark-seen route defined once.
- python -c "import codx.junior.chat.chat_engine, codx.junior.engine.chat_engine_actions, codx.junior.app" succeeds.
- A chat with mode="agent" answers once and does not recurse.

RULES
- Minimal, focused diffs; keep existing formatting and imports tidy where you touch them.
- Do not touch db.py, chat_manager.py, smol_agent.py, planning_manager.py or the kanban storage in this task.
- Do not start any long_running/ code here: this task only cleans the ground.
